`chitubox_siraya_blu_50um.cfg` is a Chitubox resin profile from https://github.com/Photonsters/CBD-based-printers-list
(`phenom/chitubox-resin-profiles`, The Unlicense). `prusaslicer_anycubic_material.ini` is the first Anycubic material section of
PrusaSlicer's `AnycubicSLA.ini` (version 2.9.6, AGPL-3.0). They are the engine's own test files (Pseudorca tests/data/resin), used here to
test the Python port of its importers (`app/resin_import.py`) with the same expected numbers.
